justification.mechanism: Sand dams, check dams, subsurface dams, ponds and production cisterns store water in sand, soil or tanks and recharge local groundwater, extending the months of water access and keeping livestock watered when other sources dry up. WOCAT compilers for gabion check dams in Tunisia, check dam ponds and a masonry check dam in Ethiopia, sand dams in Kenya, stone check walls in India, on-farm ponds in Cambodia and a haffir and gabion check dams in Somalia judge them to improve water harvesting, quantity or availability [ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_1400_2011_water_quantity, ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_1547_2012_harvesting_collection_of_water, ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_2844_2017_water_quantity, ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_7777_2026_harvesting_collection_of_water]. In Zimbabwe the months per year water could be collected at sand-dam sites rose from 6.5 to 10.9 after construction, and from 5.8 to 9.7 in a drought year, while in Kenya the average distance to a water source fell from 3 to 1 km [ev_water_access_deficit_lazurko24_2, ev_water_access_deficit_lazurko24_1, ev_water_access_deficit_lasage08_1]. A check-dam review reports that check dams storing seasonal runoff solve local supply scarcity; traditional rainwater ponds in South Korea reduced the occurrence of water deficit from 30 to 20% [ev_water_access_deficit_luca21_1, ev_water_access_deficit_silv26_1]. Water productivity, the grain produced per unit of rain, is a route by which capture eases water stress. The WOCAT guideline authors rate improving water productivity for the macrocatchment group at the middle mark of their scale [ev_rain_water_productivity_wocwh13_3].
justification.conditionality: Many Kenyan sand dams lack capacity to supply even one household through the dry season, and only part of assessed dams would hold enough water for reported beneficiaries [ev_water_access_deficit_ritc21_3, ev_water_access_deficit_neuf17_1]. Several literature units are review citations or vote counts, the WOCAT units are practitioner judgements, and the Ethiopian compiler notes that off-site impacts of the recently built check dam still need assessment [ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_6716_2023_water_availability]. The Zimbabwean sand-dam figures rely on recall of conditions before construction [ev_water_access_deficit_lazurko24_2]. The check-dam and pond findings are secondary citations in reviews, and the Korean result is modelled in a high-income setting [ev_water_access_deficit_silv26_1]. The Somali haffir compiler itself records improved local water availability with little positive downstream effects [ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_7777_2026_water_availability]. Groundwater-recharge evidence for these structures now sits in the catchment water yield rows, which also answer what upstream capture does to water downstream. That is a group-level judgement by the guideline authors, direction only [ev_rain_water_productivity_wocwh13_3].

effect_mechanism: Spate and water-spreading systems divert floodwater onto fields: WOCAT compilers for jessour in Tunisia, spate irrigation in Eritrea, water spreading in Sudan, marab floodplain agriculture in Jordan and water spreading weirs in Ethiopia judge them to improve water harvesting, and the Ethiopian compiler credits the weirs with a positive contribution to groundwater in adjacent farms [ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_6715_2023_water_availability]. Water productivity, the grain produced per unit of rain, is a route by which capture eases water stress. The WOCAT guideline authors rate improving water productivity for the floodwater harvesting group at the lowest positive mark on their scale [ev_rain_water_productivity_wocwh13_2].
conditionality: The WOCAT units are practitioner judgements rather than measurements. The Sudan compiler judges no change in water availability [ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_1292_2015_water_availability], and the Ethiopian compiler notes the weirs are too recent to judge off-site impacts [ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_6715_2023_water_availability]. The Yemeni groundwater reports now sit in the spate catchment water yield row. That is a group-level judgement by the guideline authors, direction only [ev_rain_water_productivity_wocwh13_2].

effect_mechanism: Terraces and stone lines capture and retain rainwater on slopes, and stone lines contribute to increased infiltration of rainwater into the soil, thereby replenishing water resources [ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_6610_2022_water_quantity, ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_6610_2022_water_availability]. WOCAT compilers judge bench terraces in Yemen, stone-wall terraces in Cabo Verde, contour stone bunds in Niger and gradoni orchard terraces in Uzbekistan to improve water harvesting, and radical terraces in Rwanda, vetiver terraces in Haiti, stone lines in Tunisia and semi-circular stone bunds in Ethiopia to improve water quantity or availability [ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_1560_2013_harvesting_collection_of_water, ev_water_access_deficit_wocat_6610_2022_water_availability]. Measured soil moisture supports this: a meta-analysis gives terraces an SMD of 40.5% for soil moisture retention [ev_soil_water_retention_tefe24_6], a global terracing synthesis finds terraced sites more efficient than slopes at conserving soil water, with a mean δsm of 1.2 [ev_soil_water_retention_wei16_1], and conversion of slopeland to leveled fields in China increased moisture retention [ev_soil_water_retention_iegchn07_2]. Water productivity, the grain produced per unit of rain, is a route by which capture eases water stress. The FAO compilers rate improving water productivity for the cross-slope barrier group at the middle mark of their scale [ev_rain_water_productivity_faoslm11_3].
conditionality: The WOCAT units are practitioner judgements, and catchment modelling in Peru found no difference in crop water distribution with partial terracing [ev_water_regulation_willem21_1]. Abandoned or degraded terraces worsen water regulation [ev_water_regulation_willem21_2]. The recharge estimates for terraces and contour ridges now sit in the terracing catchment water yield row. The terracing ratio is an unweighted mean across extracted cases from mixed-income countries [ev_soil_water_retention_wei16_1], and the Chinese finding comes from an independent World Bank evaluation reporting project monitoring with no control [ev_soil_water_retention_iegchn07_2]. That is a compiler judgement for a group spanning earth bunds, stone lines, vegetative strips and fanya juu terraces, direction only [ev_rain_water_productivity_faoslm11_3].
